fields.description: Display name shown under the thumbnail in the Wallpaper picker.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: The wallpaper image, drawn cover/center behind the desktop. Set for an image wallpaper (a shipped default or a user upload); absent for a CSS-gradient wallpaper.
fields.label: Image

fields.description: A small (web-sized) version of Image the Wallpaper picker grid draws instead of the full background, so the gallery never loads full-resolution files (ADR-0036). A shipped image carries one; absent for a gradient or a user upload (which falls back to Image).
fields.label: Thumbnail

fields.description: A CSS background value (gradient) drawn behind the desktop when there is no image. The presentation of the built-in gradient wallpapers; ignored when Image is set.
fields.label: Background

fields.description: The section the wallpaper is grouped under in the picker (e.g. Colors, Photos). A shipped default carries one; a user upload leaves it blank and is grouped under 'Your Wallpapers'.
fields.label: Category

fields.description: The wallpaper is dark, so desktop-icon labels and chrome read in the light palette over it (App.vue).
fields.label: Dark

fields.description: A shipped wallpaper available to every user. Cleared (private to the owner) for a user upload. Only seeding/admins create global rows; the upload path always forces this off.
fields.label: Global

fields.description: The fallback wallpaper applied when a user has not chosen one. Exactly one global row carries this (the OS ground, Duotone).
fields.label: Default
